title: Amazing Authentic Ukrainian Sausage Casserole
description: A fresh and cozy Ukrainian dish featuring Italian fennel sausages in a miso marinade, perfect for a low-glycemic friendly meal. This casserole is filled with gooey cheese and savory sausage.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together miso paste and olive oil to make the marinade.
Add sliced Italian fennel sausages to the marinade and mix well to coat.
In a large skillet, cook the sausage over medium heat until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add broken cauliflower florets to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
In a large casserole dish, combine cooked sausage, onion, garlic, and cauliflower mixture.
Top the casserole with shredded mozzarella cheese and season with salt and black pepper.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
